newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican mine explosion kills at least three - TV.
newsitem.headline: Mexican mine explosion kills at least three - TV.

text.p: An explosion early on Tuesday at a iron ore mine in the western state of Michoacan killed at least three miners and injured an unknown number of others, the television network Televisa said.
No cause was given by Televisa for the blast in the San Isidro de Tepalcatepec mine close to the Jalisco state border.
"We do not know how many miners could have been working inside the mine when the explosion happened," Televisa said. It gave no sources for its information.
Spokesmen from the National Mining Chamber were not immediately available to confirm the explosion or give details about the mine.

Officials at the Michoacan state communications department said they could only confirm that the explosion happened in the Tepalcatpec zone in the wild western regions of the largely agricultural state.
